findings.location: Definition, paragraph 2: “A thermal-contact protocol for two states x,y∈T.”
findings.evidence: Paragraph 1 defines T as tagged pairs (c,x) with x∈D_c. Thus x,y∈T are tagged pairs, but paragraph 2 treats them as untagged state coordinates in the compound protocol. The definition needs tagged states (c_A,x),(c_B,y)∈T or a separately defined untagged state family. The assigned consumer directly lists this item and cites it as Fact F3; its explicit energy-exchange and bilateral-feasibility hypotheses otherwise supply the local variation, but the dependency remains malformed.
